name: corvio-workspace
description: Collaborate with Corvio throughout Coding-Agent work through one shared Skill, CLI, and remote MCP lifecycle.

interface.shortDescription: Ground work in Corvio and return durable results.
interface.longDescription: Use Corvio's OAuth remote MCP and official Skills as a shared Coding-Agent work loop: retrieve authorized context, collaborate through documents and comments, materialize valuable results in the right carrier, close the originating handoff, and import selected local work without widening local access.
defaultPrompt: Use Corvio context that can improve this coding task, then return the verified result to the originating document or thread.
Turn this valuable result into the right durable Corvio artifact and preserve its source lineage.
Preview selected local agent work before importing it; do not capture unrelated private work.
